evals.name: chat-paste-no-timezone
evals.prompt:
here's the slack thread from last night's outage, can you write it up for the team?

[22:41] jenna: db-primary cpu pegged at 100%, api latency spiking
[22:44] marcus: I'm paging ops, looks like the nightly report job started early
[22:52] marcus: killed the report job, cpu dropping
[22:58] jenna: latency back to normal. marcus did u forget to add the job to the off-peak schedule?
[23:05] marcus: yeah my bad, I'll fix it tomorrow
[23:10] priya (eng mgr): ok we are good. need a read replica for reports imo
evals.expected: Timezone: UNKNOWN; no names; no blame on Marcus; duration not invented (22:41-22:58 may be derived).

evals.name: event-list-with-timezone-out-of-order
evals.prompt:
Can you do an incident review from this list of events? All times UTC, 2026-10-03.
- 09:40 customer support lead Sam reports login failures from EU users
- 09:12 TLS cert for auth.example.com expired
- 10:05 Alex (SRE) renewed cert and deployed
- 09:50 incident declared, Alex is IC
- cert renewal was manual, calendar reminder had been sent to a former employee's mailbox
- action: automate renewals w/ cert-manager, owner platform team, by 2026-11-15
- action: add expiry monitoring, owner SRE
evals.expected: Sorted timeline, Timezone UTC, due date 2026-11-15 only for first action, second UNKNOWN, no names.

evals.name: very-thin-notes
evals.prompt: need a postmortem. notes: search was down for a while this morning, Bob fixed it by restarting something. that's all i know
evals.expected: Short doc, many UNKNOWN markers, nothing invented, Timezone: UNKNOWN, no Bob.

evals.name: blame-bait-and-dates
evals.prompt: write up what happened. our intern Kevin ran the migration script against prod instead of staging (dumb mistake honestly, he should've checked) around 3pm PST Tuesday. dropped the orders_archive table. Lisa the DBA restored from backup, took ~2 hours, 3pm to 5pm. lost about 40 min of writes. we need to get prod/staging creds separated - Lisa to own it, due Friday. also should alert on DROP TABLE in prod, devops owns, no date yet. backup restore went smoothly at least
evals.expected: No Kevin/Lisa names; no blame; Timezone PST; 'Friday' is not a date so Due UNKNOWN; types correct.

evals.name: casual-ask-no-keyword
evals.prompt: hey can you turn this into something I can send to leadership? our payments webhook queue backed up Mon, Dana noticed the lag dashboard turning red at 4:15 (our time, ET), ~12k webhooks delayed. Raj scaled the consumers from 4 to 16 at 4:40 and queue drained by 5:30. Root cause was a partner sending a burst of retries. we had no rate limit on that endpoint. customers saw late order confirmations. leadership wants to know it won't happen again.
evals.expected: Six sections, Timezone ET, summary ≤3 sentences, no Dana/Raj, no promise-it-won't-happen invented; impact numbers only from notes.
